title: Effect of Strength-resistance Exercise in the Reduction of Gestational Diabetes in Pregnant Women with Overweight or Obesity
official: Efecto Del Ejercicio De Fuerza-resistencia En La Disminución De La Diabetes Gestacional En Gestantes Con Sobrepeso U Obesidad
summary: The aim of this trial is to test the efficacy of regular resistance exercise in early pregnancy to prevent gestational diabetes mellitus in overweight/ obese pregnant women.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI≥25 kg/m2
* Singleton pregnancies

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chronic hypertension
* Pre-pregnancy DM (type I or 2 diabetes mellitus)
* Cardiovascular disease
* History of preterm delivery
